record.original_question: Obtain upper bounds for 1/|zeta'(rho)| as rho ranges over the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function.

evidence.quote: Problem: Can we obtain upper bounds for 1/|ζ′(ρ)| as ρ runs over the nontrivial zeros of ζ(s)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\zeta(s)$ denote the Riemann zeta function, the meromorphic continuation to $\mathbb{C}$ of the Dirichlet series $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n^{-s}$ (for $\Re(s)>1$). A nontrivial zero of $\zeta$ is a zero $\rho = \beta + i\gamma$ with $0 < \beta < 1$. Assume the Riemann Hypothesis, so that every nontrivial zero has the form $\rho = \tfrac{1}{2} + i\gamma$ with $\gamma \in \mathbb{R}$, and assume further that all nontrivial zeros are simple, so that $\zeta'(\rho) \neq 0$.

Problem: Establish upper bounds for the quantity
$$\frac{1}{|\zeta'(\rho)|}$$
as $\rho$ ranges over the nontrivial zeros of $\zeta(s)$. More precisely, find a function $f(\gamma)$ (as explicit and as small as possible, e.g., a power of $\log|\gamma|$ or of $|\gamma|$) such that
$$\frac{1}{|\zeta'(\tfrac{1}{2}+i\gamma)|} \le f(\gamma)$$
holds for every nontrivial zero $\tfrac{1}{2}+i\gamma$ (or for all such zeros outside a sparse exceptional set).
artifact.status_search_result: Obtaining individual upper bounds for $1/|\zeta'(\rho)|$ remains an open problem. Only conditional results on discrete moments $\sum_{\gamma\le T} |\zeta'(\rho)|^{-2k}$ are known (e.g., work of Gonek, Hughes, Milinovich and others), together with conjectures (Gonek–Hejhal) predicting the average size. No unconditional or even RH-conditional pointwise upper bound is known.

status_evidence.title: Upper bounds for the moments of zeta prime rho
status_evidence.snippet: Upper bound for the 2k-th moment of the derivative of the Riemann zeta-function averaged over the non-trivial zeros of ζ(s), assuming RH.
status_evidence.claim: Only moment-type bounds, not pointwise bounds, are established.

status_evidence.title: An upper bound for discrete moments of the derivative of the Riemann zeta-function
status_evidence.snippet: Upper bound for discrete moments at nontrivial zeros assuming RH.
status_evidence.claim: Research focuses on averaged moments rather than individual upper bounds on 1/|ζ'(ρ)|.
